skipped.reason: REJECTED / WIN: a live model call would add cost, latency, and hallucination pressure before the source-bound editorial lane has a publication cadence. The committed-day compiler is the safer first public contract.
FALSE PREMISE / WIN: the named REX, MARA, and DOT voices already expose stance, confidence, sources, and dated predictions. Another generic summary voice would reduce accountability.
SCOPE REJECTION / WIN: News is public editorial content and remains architecturally separate from identity. Obelisk gates the stable staging deploy, not the News product model.
SECURITY HOLD: production callback registration is green, but the exact stable staging callback remains provider-rejected. CANON-007 forbids bypassing that gate to make the menu visible.

notes: S307 founder-directed News graduation audit. Premises were checked against the live generator, public artifacts, 29,934-token code sample, navigation propagator, content-lane policy, current Obelisk provider behavior, and rendered pixels. Candidate generation covered all nine axes; low-value duplicate widgets, runtime model calls, and identity coupling were culled. Every retained item names the information-finding or trust outcome.

items.title: Graduate The Desk with a source-bound real edition
items.why: PRE-VERIFIED: the public tree contained only simulated fixture reporting and was correctly noindexed. Outcome: visitors can read a real, dated edition whose factual claims resolve to primary sources and whose commentary is visibly separated from fact.
items.recipe: L2: commit a non-simulated day using primary sources, retain fact/stance/prediction boundaries, generate two article pages and social cards, and remove the fictional public corpus.

L1.recipe: One real story with primary-source facts and explicit AI disclosure.

L2.recipe: Two-story edition, named debate, dated predictions, social cards, and fictional-corpus retirement.

L3.recipe: L2 plus source-change monitoring and a formal corrections ledger.

executionLog.note: Published a two-story source-bound edition from OpenAI and Google DeepMind primary sources; removed the simulated public day and outputs.

items.title: Make simulation incapable of becoming public News
items.why: PRE-VERIFIED: the prior --simulate path wrote public artifacts, so a fixture could drift into a launch tree. Outcome: editors can exercise the pipeline without creating a plausible-looking public falsehood.
items.recipe: L2: make --simulate validation-only; add --rebuild over simulated:false days; deterministically rebuild pages, carousel, claims, prediction chain, and cards; fail --check on any drift.

L1.recipe: Filter simulated days from page generation.

L2.recipe: Validation-only simulation plus deterministic real-only rebuild and convergence checks.

L3.recipe: L2 plus signed editorial approvals per committed day.

executionLog.note: Simulation is now permanently non-publishing; news:preview and news:publish expose the safe intent split.

items.title: Put The Desk where visitors actually look
items.why: PRE-VERIFIED: /news existed but had no header/footer route and was omitted from sitemap generation. Outcome: a visitor can find News from the Studio menu or footer without knowing the URL, and crawlers receive the same public state.
items.recipe: L2: add The Desk · News to canonical Studio navigation and footer, propagate to every public page, include News in sitemap/discovery, and test the real dropdown click.

L2.recipe: Canonical header/footer propagation, sitemap graduation, orphan checks, and browser interaction regression.

L3.recipe: L2 plus route-aware latest-edition preview in the nav sheet.

executionLog.note: The Desk · News now propagates through 113 headers/footers, resolves from the Studio dropdown, and is present in the sitemap.

items.title: Turn The Desk into a source-preserving subscription surface
items.why: PRE-VERIFIED: claims.ndjson serves auditors but no subscriber-friendly feed exists. Outcome: readers and agents can follow canonical articles while retaining each story's source URLs, disagreement heat, and prediction count.
items.recipe: L2: deterministically emit JSON Feed 1.1 at /api/news-desk-feed.json, add rel=alternate to every News page, advertise it from the hub and agent discovery, and bind it to news:check.

L2.recipe: L1 plus source, heat, prediction metadata, page discovery, and drift checks.

L3.recipe: L2 plus RSS and WebSub when a recurring cadence exists.

executionLog.note: Added deterministic JSON Feed 1.1 with canonical URLs and VaultSpark provenance extensions; no new dependency or runtime cost.

items.title: Prove News in pixels and behavior, not source code
items.why: PRE-VERIFIED: the launch changes touch three templates, seven themes, desktop/mobile hierarchy, and a hidden dropdown interaction. Outcome: visitors receive a readable, reachable Desk across the actual supported presentation matrix.
items.recipe: L2: capture 42 hash-bound states, inspect rendered contact sheets, run the actual dropdown/footer path, and execute the accessibility suite.

L1.recipe: Dark/light desktop/mobile capture and interaction smoke.

L2.recipe: All seven themes on three routes at desktop/mobile plus interaction and Axe coverage.

L3.recipe: L2 plus visual baselines for article body states and feed-reader validation.

executionLog.note: Reviewed 42 rendered states with zero blocking defects; dropdown click passed and accessibility completed 23/23.

items.title: Distinguish production registration from staging registration
items.why: PRE-VERIFIED: a generic 'registered' claim cannot identify which callback Obelisk accepts. Outcome: the release verdict names the exact working origin and prevents a production-only registration from being mistaken for staging readiness.
items.recipe: L2: probe staging and production callbacks independently with altered-host and foreign-client negatives, then preserve the canonical staging receipt as the release authority.

L2.recipe: Differential staging/production probes plus two tenant-negative controls.

L3.recipe: L2 plus provider-signed multi-redirect registration receipt.

executionLog.note: Production callback passes and both negative controls reject; canonical staging callback is still rejected as redirect-not-registered. Provider configuration must add the exact staging URI before deployment.
